retries: No independent statistical repetitions; fixes receive focused regression; infrastructure failures are retained.
oracle: Public entry/exit predicate checks, stale-order lifetime and position checks, causal prefix comparison, independent fee/account ledger. Published upstream patch is compared only after submission.
scope_limits: Three selected historical bug versions supported by merged upstream PRs; not current-version vulnerabilities or random prevalence estimates.
Legacy ADX API uses an explicitly recorded bridge; native matching engine is Freqtrade 2026.8.
Held-out later historical periods are not sent to agent; no upstream fixed source or PR patch is sent to model or baseline containers.
market_selection: ADX visible market changed from BTC 2024 Q1 to ETH 2024 Q1 after zero exit-predicate coverage; full selection log retained. All final inputs and later-period holdouts frozen before agent calls.
